notes.title: NOW AVAILABLE! Demo v0.2
notes.content:
Hello blasters!

We have just released the latest version of Master Blaster demo for the Steam NextFest!

In more detail the new version includes:
[list]
[*] Campaign Mode with 12 levels including boss fight
[*] Revamped map system
[*] Custom controls remapping
[*] Controller finetuning (aim sensitivity, aim deadzone adjustment, aim acceleration, vibration intensity)
[*] Revamped Tutorial System for better player onboarding
[*] Gameplay and Map HUDs explanations
[*] New enemy Graphics
[*] New environment graphics and animations
[*] UI polishing and animations
[*] New Hazard: Black Hole
[*] New Hazard Setups for both campaign and survival mode
[*] New Hazard mechanic: Field Multiplier to enable pinball-like behaviors
[*] Bug Fixes
[/list]


We hope you enjoy our demo and support us with your comments to make Master Blaster better!

Be safe and don't forget to wishlist (it really helps!)

Have a blasting NextFest!

notes.title: Demo Patch v1.1 - Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Demo v1.1 is released with the following updates:

[list]
    [*]Fix: Optimized progression of Survival Level for a smoother and more normalized user experience.
    [*]Fix: Reduced time Buffs stay on board to optimize experience on later, more challenging waves.
    [*]Feature: Overall Tutorial System revamp, enabling handling of gameplay events.
    [*]Feature: Event-generated tutorial pop-ups to guide players in better managing their shots and avoid energy being depleted in initial waves.
[/list]

As always, our [url=https://discord.gg/hqcmEPzRCj] Discord [/url] is open for your ideas, suggestions or support requests.

Yannis
Lost Cabinet Games
